notes: Parts 09-12 (40 groups). Lookups used: 25/25 (17 WebSearch + 8 WebFetch; citybiz Wabi fetch returned 403). SKIPPED as already stored in data/rounds.json with the same amount: 'indias eloelo' (EloElo Group $80M), 'truth' (&Truth $70M seed), 'secretive israeli' article 0cd3e867ddb0 (Spines $64M), 'ultra' Series A $50M and 'warehouse workstation robot maker' (Ultra $50M Series A). No CONFLICTs found. MERGED groups: 'multiply' + 'this robotics' (same Multiply Labs $75M Series B); 'nevis' 3 articles; 'wabi' + '4179996c13af' (same Wabi $55M round); 'sabi' + 'mind reading baseball cap startup' (same Sabi $50M seed); 'hyphenate' + 'maximor' (Hyphenate, formerly Maximor, $45M Series A); 'applied' + 'baba' (same Baba $40M Series A). SPLIT rounds: Ultra -> emitted only the earlier $12M seed (Fortune), Series A already stored; Broccoli $52M -> Series A $22M + Series B $30M per Fortune-derived coverage (Pulse2 only gives the $52M total; Seedtable lists a $25M Series A in July 2026 - split uncertain; both rows dated to the Oct 28 announcement, Series A actually closed ~9 months earlier). AIR $50M -> $10M seed (Sequoia) + $40M seed (Greenoaks). Pluto Security $42M -> $8.5M seed (TLV Partners) + $34M Series A (Jump Capital). Jazz: the $61M (seed + Series A) was actually announced 2026-03-11, outside the 120-day window; the Google News item dated 2026-10-03 is a re-surfaced story. Row kept with the article date and exclude_reason 'duplicate' so the merge drops it; round_type set to Venture - Unspecified because it is a combined seed+Series A total. Evidence spans for rows whose part-file text was thin/unresolved come verbatim from WebSearch result summaries or WebFetch extracts of the URLs listed in source_urls (Volantis, Powerlattice, Axonica, Multiply Labs, Nevis investors, Blacksmith, Hone, Mecka extra investors, Albert, Wabi extra investors, Broccoli, Gallatin, Reach Security, Different, Coherence, Baba, Jazz, TeddyHoldings HQ). The validator may not find them in part-file text. HQ 'unknown' where no source I read stated it (likely US but unverified, please check): Volantis, Hone, Reach Security; Mecka AI described as 'Toronto- and New York City-based' so left unknown. Nevis: most sources say New York, some say London and New York. Blacksmith: 'US-based' per Inc42 title, city not stated. Harmonic Security: dateline San Francisco and London, set US. Baba: New York (one source says Miami). Gallatin AI: El Segundo (one aggregator says San Francisco). Scarlet GB/London is from general knowledge, not from the text read. Judgment calls on is_ai_ml: TeddyHoldings.AI false (founder: 'Teddy is not an AI company'); Blacksmith true but borderline (CI infrastructure marketed as AI code testing); Scarlet false (certifies AI medical devices); Coherence Neuro false (implant; AI not described in text read); Dougs false (accounting firm). Coherence round type: cofounder says Series A, WIRED says seed. Axonica: round described as 'up to $80M' and still being finalized as of mid-October; $50M was in hand. Rebel Audio: Series A 'targets a $10M close' at ~$50M post-money valuation - amount set to the $10M target. 'Secretive Israeli' CTech article (Ackman/Schmidt-backed) is a different, unnamed company from Spines; emitted with amount null. Airwallex-backed start-up (AFR): company not identified, amount 'nearly $50m' likely AUD, left null. Currency conversions at 1.08: Metaview EUR 53.1M -> $57.35M; Dougs EUR 50M -> $54M.
